We have train.csv and test.csv. Need to train XGBoost model with given hyperparameters and target column formation_energy_per_atom. Use train_xgboost_model tool. Provide paths. Save model to a path within workspace, e.g., /Users/.../0_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_12/trained_xgboost_model.pkl.

Let's call train_xgboost_model.
